annotations.title: Submit your post for a campaign

description: Requires a JWT and a claimed page with a linked X account. Submit ONE post of your own backing a live support campaign (`campaign_id` from `campaigns`; `post_url` = an x.com status link or id). The post must be by your linked X account, made after the campaign started, and quote, reply to or link the official post (or carry your rokha.ai/?ref=<handle> link). Resubmitting a different post replaces yours (one a minute, 20 per campaign). Refusals: needs_x_link · not_your_post · posted_before_start · not_about_campaign · campaign_not_live · already_submitted. Returns {ok, points, share_link}.

post_url.description: Your own post: https://x.com/<you>/status/<id> or the id
